suites.name: pagination
suites.detail: limit honoured, cursor pages do not overlap over 3 pages, search finds a row, codes status filter holds on page 2, installations page, ids+ip masked, events page, type filter, limit capped at 200, overview loads

suites.name: secret migration
suites.detail: signed link cookie via env session secret, forged link 401, api without session 401, ffAccessBot 401 without secret, ffAccessBot 200 with env secret

suites.name: concurrency
suites.detail: 5 installations race one code -> exactly one winner, one activation id, only winner active; 3 duplicate claims from the same installation -> one surviving activation; late retry reused

suites.name: revocation and reset
suites.detail: revoked device 403 at next verify, reset returns RESET, device active on one handle

suites.name: rate limit cleanup
suites.detail: job runs, keeps last two windows, writes a rate_cleanup event

suites.name: admin actions
suites.detail: stats, settings registry, users detail, installs reveal audit, codes list, profile

known_limits: the platform allows 70 entity operations per minute per caller; a burst of parallel redemptions can exhaust it and the API answers 500 instead of a clean 503
no unique constraint, no compare-and-swap and no transaction on entities: at-least-once writes are corrected by settling and by compensating deletes, not by atomicity
the panel UI still requests one page of 200 rows; the cursor API is live but the browser has no Load more control yet
